name: acceptance-gate
description: Acceptance gate for AI-generated features. Normalizes requirements into acceptance contracts, self-generates eval cases across 4 executor types, verifies with fresh-context subagents, and enforces evidence-backed verdicts via deterministic hooks. Includes a design-quality gate (a11y/contrast, AI-slop) for web-UI surfaces. v1.16 adds the morphological-scan coverage skill (Zwicky-box AC-space enumeration with per-axis CE evidence) and a contract Coverage section surfaced on the Gate-1 card. v1.17 adds the Layout Contract discipline + layout meter (measure_layout.js) to ux-ui-craft, pairing with design-loop's layout-token-only blocking rule. v1.18 adds the S1 gap-probe: a clean-context critic probes the Gate-1 artifact set one-pass (design/contract/evals/ledger), dispositions are P0-not-silent, and the Gate-1 card renders the 'Phản biện context sạch' block with fail-visible flags, plus the gate decision commands /approve (Gate 1) and /signoff (Gate 2) and the /acceptance-report metrics aggregator (minutes vs baseline, verdict mix, gate hygiene). Puts the human at the few real decision moments instead of inside the loop. v1.19 adds the cross-layer false-green rail (wave 1): a (cross-layer) contract tag + backend-effect pairing rule + lint W4 + an advisory network-truth vocab (network_observed) in ui-check evidence with app-origin scoping, plus degradation stances for network-blind drivers (curl/mobile). v1.20 makes mobile a first-class surface (native-E2E test lane, UI-layer evidence only, W5 backend-target presence check) and gives pairing rule (c) CI teeth — pre-merge BLOCKS a (cross-layer) criterion with no layer: backend-effect eval — plus a network_observed distribution readout in /acceptance-report. v1.20.1 closes a section-scan bug class shared by four parsers (pre-merge teeth, coverage lint, gate-card, evidence-page): a `###` sub-heading inside `## Criteria` no longer truncates the scan, so criteria after it are still gated, linted and rendered on the Gate-1 card. v1.22 adds the rules ledger to pre-merge-check.sh: clean must be PROVEN — every rule block records ran/declared-off through one ledger_mark chokepoint against a fixed EXPECTED list, a machine-readable summary line (pre-merge-check: rules ran= declared-off= expected=) whose expected count is derived from EXPECTED rather than from the running totals, and any ledger mismatch is an internal-gate error (exit 2). This catches silently-skipped rule blocks that no input-validation blacklist could enumerate. v1.22.1 hardening wave: declared-but-unusable scope/filter values now exit 2 as a class (empty --base/--slug, typo'd or /-containing slug filters, PRE_MERGE_BASE set-but-empty with +x set-detection, declared base on a git-less root), an explicit --base still overrides an empty env var, VIOLATION [scope] prints on stdout like every other VIOLATION. (Repo-internal maintenance tooling also hardened — sync-plugin-packages.sh rejects extra argv — but that script ships only in the kit repo, not in this package.) v1.23 renders the Gate-2 "Ngoài hợp đồng" block on the decision card: real defects that fall outside the approved scope are shown as human work with three explicit choices (known limits / new contract / widen scope), plus the coverage-cluster flag; a review-findings.md without those sections renders exactly as before. v1.24 stops an unjudged PASS at the merge boundary: a directory that CLAIMS release (evidence declaring verdict PASS, or a contract at status implemented+) can no longer be invisible to the gate — missing contract.md, risk_tier or status is now a VIOLATION instead of a silent skip, while an abandoned scaffold stays silent by design; and a human_signoff that is a placeholder rather than a name (PENDING/TBD/TODO/n/a/none/unsigned/waiting, a bare > | -, or an unfilled <...> template) is rejected, with a NOTE stating plainly that this prefix list is short and fixed so rewording is not a fix. signoff.approvers stays informational and is deliberately NOT parsed. v1.25 adds single-sourced per-section markdown boundary (lib/md-section.js) shared by gate-card and evidence-page. v1.26 adds the design-pass in-harness design ritual: a dedicated aesthetics+UX session on the running clickable build in the Browser pane (S1-D), with a 3-rung material ladder (real-components/scaffold/static, declared in the session note), a named DS-rule ladder (repo skill → repo tokens → shadcn default), hard token-only constraints (no new hex, no webfonts, no components/ui edits), and a state×breakpoint×theme capture note written back to the feature workspace for Gate 1. v1.27 ships references/opportunity-template.md — the discovery Cổng-0 opportunity mold with machine-readable frontmatter (OPP-FRONTMATTER-TEMPLATE marker, round-trip-tested against the kit's real frontmatter reader) and the "Nguồn ngoài & phạm vi kế thừa" inheritance-classification field (philosophy/logic inheritable; design-language/form defaults to NO — the consuming repo's standard wins, and unclassified external material blocks the Cổng-0 signature). v1.28 ships references/human-facing-language.md — the human-facing language law (N1-N6 + two quick tests + before/after examples) as an enforced reference the card, report and status renderers must load before writing a single human-facing sentence, plus two marked presentation templates: PLAN-SUMMARY-TABLE-TEMPLATE (three columns: what the user sees / what it touches / which criteria it serves) and DECISION-DIAGRAM-TEMPLATE (mermaid, triggered when a decision point has three or more sequential steps or two or more branches). The law table is byte-identical across its two homes (the enforced reference and the workflow spec) and the reviewer may reject a card at the gate, logging it to the decisions ledger as a kit defect. v1.29: hình tại điểm quyết định chọn theo mặt phẳng qua bảng tra DECISION-DIAGRAM-SURFACES, kèm phép thử nhìn-thấy-hình. v1.30: /start session-entry ritual (human-typed, both harnesses locked). v1.31: bản đồ sản phẩm máy sinh (PRODUCT-MAP.md) + nghi thức phiên nghiệm thu (Cổng Giá trị). v1.32: thẻ nói tiếng người trọn câu — bullet Coverage/Out-of-scope hard-wrap được nối trọn dòng, khối Coverage + gap-probe nối vào tầng card-plain (key coverage_plain/gap_probe_plain, khuôn CARD-PLAIN-KEYS hai chiều), mọi fallback in text thô của contract/ledger/probe đều lột dấu markdown; sev finding vẫn do script render và overlay không giấu được hàng nào. v1.32.1 hotfix: the re-pin sha-match rule becomes an aggregate relation (every cited lane must exist with all-zero suites_exit; at least ONE cited lane must match verified_commit) — the per-section form falsely flagged every historical Re-pin section the moment a SECOND re-pin event landed. v1.33 adds judge-required-evidence: a non-PASS judge verdict must carry required_evidence[] (each item one concrete piece of evidence + where to get it; a lazy judge is exposed by the pinned marker instead of silently tolerated), the Gate-2 card renders the missing-evidence list per judgment item, the judge persona gains the actionable/no-evidence-shopping rules, and scripts/acceptance-gold.mjs derives the gold set (human decisions over machine proposals from existing Gate-2 signatures) plus the judge-agreement (G3) report consumed by /acceptance-report — purely derived, no new files. v1.38 unifies the workspace-record law: evidence-report verdict joins NAV_RULES (usesEvidence/missingArtifact), one MAP_LABELS table for product-map --check and /start (mapState), configList reads key-line comments, --root fails loud, and the UAT-COPY-PROCEDURE block makes the uat-session template copy procedure machine-extractable. v1.39 ships the measure-birth reference mold (references/measure-birth.md: positive-control / break-the-real-object / pinned-message sections, two living samples from the kit's own suite, and the defect-class table sourced from docs/research/known-limits-ledger.tsv — the known-limits lifecycle ledger introduced alongside), backing the MEASURE-BIRTH-CLAUSE in feature-loop ≥ 1.27. v1.39 also upstreams two pre-merge fixes a consuming repo had been carrying locally: (a) the cross-layer pairing rule compared the bare code against the WHOLE criterion string (grep -qx), so any repo writing `criterion: AC-7 (human-readable text)` got a false VIOLATION on EVERY (cross-layer) criterion — now anchored with a non-digit boundary so AC-1 no longer matches AC-16 either; and (b) an unresolvable verified_commit is no longer a blanket NOTE: in a provably non-shallow clone it is a VIOLATION (phantom pin), because a pin that does not exist means staleness is not being checked at all while the gate still prints clean. NOTE FOR UPGRADERS: (b) is a NEW BLOCKING RULE and can turn a previously green repo red — that is the bar working, not a regression; re-pin the flagged slugs against a commit on the target branch. v1.39.1 bugfix (the consumer-copy class caught by GD2 game 1): every file acceptance-init copies into a consumer repo is now .cjs — recheck-evidence.cjs plus the five lib files (evidence-core, gap-probe, workspace-record, ac-line, md-section) — because a consumer package.json declaring "type": "module" made Node read the copied .js files as ESM, their require() threw ReferenceError, the committed-evidence re-check had NEVER run since init and the gap-probe rule degraded to NOT ENFORCED, all while the kit's self-hosted suites stayed green. The init copy list now names ALL SEVEN files inside a machine-readable INIT-CI-COPY-LIST marker; a generated type:module consumer sim round-trips that list (green: recheck exit 0 and pre-merge with rules ran=3 and zero NOT-ENFORCED lines; red: the pre-fix .js layout must fail with the pinned ReferenceError), and the used-files/copy-list relation is machine-checked so a lib added to pre-merge without a copy-list entry turns the suite red. v1.40.0 is a release-numbering fix plus the five gate-UX chips that landed on top of 1.39.1: (1) staleness scoped to the PR diff, so a signed-off profile goes stale only when the diff really touches its code, with the whole verified_commit block (phantom pins included) read as one unit; (2) every gate card ends with a 'VIEC CUA ANH' block naming the one thing the human must do, and the machine never pre-writes the human's own answer; (3) teeth on the gate evals themselves - layer-isolating mutants, two-directional source counting, sentence-boundary anchors; (4) one-shot gate typing: the human answers every gate field in a single line (with --repo), the gate infers identity/date/profile, stops asking for minutes, and offers a recommendation with its grounds instead of an open question. NOTE FOR UPGRADERS: chips (2)-(4) shipped while the number stood still at 1.39.2, so `claude plugin update` may have skipped you silently. Verify by content, not by number - grep 'VIEC CUA ANH' in scripts/gate-card.js and 'GATE-ONESHOT-GRAMMAR' in skills/acceptance/references/human-facing-language.md - and uninstall+install if either is missing. v1.41.0 archives the twin Codex harness and retires the design-loop ceremony: the `design-loop` plugin is gone from this marketplace, the flat `plugins/` mirror and its sync script are gone, and the UI lane now routes to the in-harness design-pass ritual scored by the `ui-check`/`design-gate` evals instead of a mockup-then-push ceremony. Everything removed is recoverable from git tag `truoc-luu-kho-2026-08` (1df86adb7da1a013adad9a4c2f14cd62a4ac9c39); ADR 0008 and 0009 record the reopen triggers. NOTE FOR UPGRADERS: `design-loop` no longer exists in the marketplace, so an already-installed copy is left dangling and `claude plugin update` cannot remove it — uninstall it explicitly, then update `acceptance-gate` and `feature-loop`. Anyone who wired `executors.design.*` by pointing at design-loop scripts must re-point those keys; GUIDE.md has a 'Wire `executors.design`' section for the manual wiring. v1.42.0 stops measuring human minutes at every gate: /acceptance-report drops the minutes-vs-baseline aggregate (the v1.18 note above is history — that aggregate no longer exists), gate cards and docs no longer promise minutes-per-gate, a trailing `, phút <số>` in one-shot gate sentences is accepted and silently ignored so a human typing it out of habit is never blocked, and time_human_minutes stays in the schema READ path only, for already-signed dossiers. Rationale: the number was self-reported at the gate to get past it — it cost a human interruption and produced fictional data at the same time, and the baseline it was divided by was deliberately left empty. What the gates actually record — verdict mix, verify rounds, gate hygiene — is what /acceptance-report prints. v2.0.0 — «người về biên»: the V lane (veto_state/veto_opened_at, T2-only, hook-validated) lets the machine close Gate 1 scope and proceed with the veto window open; the Evidence Gate stops inviting a signature when a PASS is clean on the six-condition closed list (verdict PASS present, 0 UNCERTAIN, no bypass, Known limits present-and-empty, Out-of-contract present-and-empty, tier T2 read from the contract); hard-to-reverse actions always stop; pre-merge counts open veto windows, blocks unresolved vetoes and the silent write-back direction. Also ships 1c behavior cuts (the 👉 block lives only on gate invites and cards; coverage scan self-builds Product Context with per-line source tags; init presents one complete draft). Consumers: gate semantics changed for T2 — read GUIDE before updating. v2.1.0 — «cổng chặn nhầm chỗ»: (1) gate invitations are no longer a form — the 👉 VIỆC CỦA ANH block and YOUR-MOVE-BLOCK-TEMPLATE are removed from every invite message (cards keep their machine-counted list); the invite clause now describes behavior: ask like a colleague — one closed question, say the machine's recommended path and why, one word answers it, then say what the machine does next — with three negative rules kept (never pre-write the human's answer, never ask for minutes, status messages never ask). (2) pre-merge understands the V lane exactly like the hook: mo + parseable stamp + T2 + (six-condition clean evidence OR a signature) → NOTE, not VIOLATION; mo on T3, a broken stamp, or mo without clean-or-signed still block; the six-condition check is one shared function. (3) ADR 0012 — the signature is a DECISION the human speaks and the machine records and commits in one pass; signoff.require_human_commit and signoff.agent_authors are retired (still readable → one NOTE per run, never a block; remove them from config.yaml), the separate human-fields-only commit ritual is gone from /signoff, SKILL, GUIDE, README, QUICKSTART, CONTEXT and the init scaffold; attribution comes from the forge (whoever approves/merges the PR) and pre-merge prints one NOTE naming a signature that first appears in the PR diff. Placeholder signatures are still rejected. (4) DIAGRAM-RULE presentation law ships in docs/reference (pictures are projections of the text source; three tiers by lifetime) and the marketplace gains a third plugin, diagram-design (vendored editorial diagram skill; skin state lives in the consuming repo at docs/reference/diagram-skin.md). NOTE FOR UPGRADERS: remove signoff.require_human_commit / agent_authors from _acceptance/config.yaml (or accept one NOTE per run); update by uninstall+install if `claude plugin update` says already latest — verify by content: grep 'xanh_sach_check' in scripts/pre-merge-check.sh. v2.2.0 — three signed rounds of 17–18/08, no schema change and no migration: (1) Gate 1 gains a «figure at the decision point» block — the loop lists the surfaces a picture would serve, counts them, draws the tier-2 figures next to the record, looks at them, and attaches them in the same pass, with the one-source rule sentence; (2) the Scope-Gate card now prints the acceptance threshold declared at the Worth Gate verbatim — or states the fact «no opportunity record → ships straight, no acceptance session»; the acceptance session (uat-session) §0 stops taking «the product runs» on trust and reads the stranger-drive log instead (chan/slug/ran_at: 0 blockers on this round and not older than the last machine verdict → condition met by evidence; blockers → stop with the way back; missing or unreadable → a yellow flag with a named reason, never a block); feature-loop S5 hands off to the Delivery round in one line instead of ending with «done», and S0 reads opportunity.md as the first input of S1; new reference template skills/acceptance/references/stranger-drive-template.md carries the machine-read frontmatter; (3) the figure-clause measurement is single-sourced (tests/plugins/hfl_clause.py) so every copy of the rule sentence is checked by one function. Consumers: nothing to migrate — a workspace with no opportunity record reads as «ships straight», a workspace with no stranger-drive log gets a yellow flag and the session still opens. v2.3.0 — seven signed rounds of 18–22/08, no schema change and no migration: (1) the /start entry ritual separates «đang cân nhắc» (an idea with an opportunity record but no threshold filled in — nothing to sign, so NOT a gate) from «chờ Cổng Đáng»; the card prints count + age of the oldest (N = 0 prints nothing) and every discovery session ends with one machine-readable stub (START-HIEU-KET block; the dead «grill» pointer is gone); scripts/start-scan.mjs gains groups.considering[] {slug, name, since, ageDays}, bullet labels read from references/opportunity-template.md at run time, since = first commit of the stub (mtime when unversioned). (2) the contract template gains a «Đường đo» section (CONTRACT-DUONG-DO-TEMPLATE marker) for rounds that come from an opportunity with a declared threshold — one line per measure: where the number will come from · which AC guarantees it; the Scope-Gate card prints the block, raises a yellow flag (never a block) when a threshold exists but the contract has no measurement path, an info flag when it was dropped by name (descope entry starting «bỏ đường-đo — »), and stays silent for rounds with no opportunity record; the S1 gap-probe cross-checks threshold ↔ measurement path; CONTEXT gains the term. (3) acceptance-init step 5b declares the tool set at repo level: scripts/plugin-declare.mjs writes .claude/settings.json (marketplace source + the kit's plugins + superpowers) by JSON merge that keeps every team key and never flips a team `false`, the init branches on its exit code (0 → commit the file; 3/4 → stderr verbatim, no commit claim), and a repo that already has config.yaml still runs 5b; GUIDE §5.1 is one marker block — first machine: marketplace add + install; later machines: marketplace add only; no version pins; diagram-design is a required plugin. (4) the /start scanner asks the same question pre-merge asks about a verified-but-unsigned T2 record («does this still need a human?» — one shared predicate, scripts/khong-can-nguoi.mjs): a V-lane record with clean evidence reads as «delivered, veto window open», not «waiting for signature». (5) a verifier killed by the tool (timeout / kill) is TOOL-KILL, never FAIL (references/tool-kill-rule.md, one source for the loop and the standalone verify path), and a record whose status has not armed the gate (draft/approved) yet already carries an evidence report is a VIOLATION when it sits in the PR diff instead of a silent skip. NOTE FOR UPGRADERS: nothing to migrate — the «đang cân nhắc» group and the «đường đo» flags only appear for records that have an opportunity.md; the age shown for an idea counts from the day its stub was committed, not from the day the idea was born; the claim that later machines need only `claude plugin marketplace add` is inferred from the harness docs and not yet observed on a second machine — if the key turns out to only enable an already-installed plugin, GUIDE §5.1 changes and the code does not. v2.4.0 — seven signed rounds of 22–26/08, no schema change and no migration: (1) every command name the kit prints is now clickable, from ONE source — the COMMAND-NAMES table (table ⊆ real artifacts, handover points ⊆ table, round-tripped), the three first-touch documents (QUICKSTART, README, GUIDE) carry 0 bare command tokens, and three noisy card flags are SUBTRACTED. (2) /start is the owner's control panel rather than a router: it shows every idea under consideration, names what the machine finished and what is still vetoable, prints ahead/behind, and every reader (scan, product map, pre-merge) says the SAME words for the same state. (3) skills/acceptance/references/ux-spec-template.md ships the UX spec mold — a ≤1-page marked section (flow · screen inventory · state table with ST- ids · behavior · component provenance · chosen IA pattern + grounds) that S1 fills into the design-doc BEFORE any of the three artifacts is generated, with a one-line waiver for non-UI rounds («bỏ đặc-tả-UX — <reason>»); Gate-1 flow/screen figures are drawn FROM that section, never by hand. Declared limit: this round ships the MOLD and the WORDING, no machine rail — after five verify rounds of the same self-deceiving-measure class the automated cross-check was cut whole, and the human reviewer inspects the spec at the Scope Gate (reopen conditions: docs/plans/2026-08-24-hat-giong-khop-vong-dac-ta-ux.md). (4) design-pass flips its default to ASYNCHRONOUS: a four-rung REACTION-LADDER (nac-0 straight through · nac-1 async on stills · nac-2 async on the clickable build · nac-3 short co-located, which only opens when a HUMAN names it), escalation on a COUNTABLE signal (same point criticised in two consecutive async rounds → invite nac-3 scoped to that point, never a whole session), a conditional divergence step that opens with the REAL existing artifact before showing new directions and sources them from the UX spec section, a four-rung builder ladder so the kit depends on NO external canvas tool, and three new session-note keys (reaction: · options: · divergence:) with no silent-skip path; the Scope-Gate card renders the rung in human words and yellow-flags older or malformed notes without blocking. (5) THE ONE BEHAVIOUR CHANGE CONSUMERS MUST READ (T3, touches lib/ and the hook and pre-merge-check.sh): «ra có tên» — the V lane gains an explicit machine-cleared state, the Worth Gate is signed through /approve one pass per PR, and the Value Gate gains a declared «cannot be measured» exit plus archived/timebox readers. (6) the fixed check commands of a repo stop asking permission per invocation, and the ritual knows how to degrade to SEQUENTIAL when fan-out is throttled by a safety classifier — measured: 7 sequential invocations = 0 blocks, 1 fan-out invocation = 3 blocks. NOTE FOR UPGRADERS: nothing to migrate. Verify by CONTENT, not by number — grep 'UX-SPEC-TEMPLATE' in skills/acceptance/references/ux-spec-template.md and 'REACTION-LADDER' in skills/design-pass/SKILL.md; uninstall+install if `claude plugin update` claims you are already latest. Two mechanisms in this release (the UX spec mold and the asynchronous design ritual) are shipped with their cost/benefit NOT yet measured: their trial run happens at a consuming repo and their Value Gate is deliberately still open. v2.5.0 — five signed rounds of 27–30/08 plus a skill-level eval suite; no schema change and no migration. What the consumer receives: (1) thuoc-nhan-de-khoi (#116) — the label-over-block measure for diagram-design figures, and the INVERTED-DEFAULT answer to the allowlist class: a measure that cannot classify guesses AGAINST the change (declared-miss, never false-acquittal). (2) suite-run-log-provenance (#117) — every suite command S4 runs now writes its provenance line into run-log.jsonl, so post-signature reconciliation reads real records instead of going red on absences. (3) khong-ve-the-ma (#121) — the gate card refuses to render a full decision card for a slug with no dossier: a two-layer guard (script + renderer), because a card for a ghost profile invites a signature on nothing. (4) cham-dung-cay-dung-cho-dung (#123, lives in feature-loop) — the S4 grading layer proves its own footing instead of narrating it. (5) nhanh-chinh-khong-ten-main (#125, lives in feature-loop) — main-branch detection that actually probes. (6) a new evals/ suite measuring the SKILL layer (plugin-eval cases: does the skill fire, does the card get built by the real renderer) — runnable once the org enables `claude plugin eval`. Release-dossier first: this release records the first hand-counted North-Star lines (rounds per loop, infra-burned rounds, meta share 5/5) and ships under the new breadth-limit law — at most ONE meta loop between releases, measure-of-measure loops parked with a declared reopen threshold. NOTE FOR UPGRADERS: nothing to migrate. Verify by content, not number: grep "MSG_NO_DOSSIER" in scripts/gate-card.js (ghost-card guard) and see the feature-loop v2.5.0 entry for the S4 footing markers; uninstall+install if `claude plugin update` claims you are already latest. v2.6.0 — ONE scope-reduced round (#133); no schema change, no migration. This is also the milestone at which the kit reads its own cut-the-kit threshold (declared 30/08). What the consumer receives: (1) the decision-card builder now tells FIVE refusal cases apart instead of three. Type the name of an idea that was parked or killed and it answers «y da dong» — this idea is closed, there is nothing to sign, reopening it is a separate decision — instead of inviting you to write an acceptance contract for a stopped idea. An opportunity file whose stage the machine cannot read answers «ho so hong» and names the exact field to fix. The navigation vocabulary is read through the shared reader (lib/workspace-record.cjs), so the session scanner and the card builder cannot reach different conclusions about the same dossier. NOT consumer-facing, stated plainly so the milestone does not inflate its own value: the rest of this round is INTERNAL to the kit repo — a permanent-net assertion that had never actually executed is revived (a helper was declared 87 lines below its first call, so bash printed «command not found» to stderr and walked on while the suite still reported 0 failed), two self-watch cases now hold that invariant as a machine-kept fact, and the khong-ve-the-ma teeth stop pinning a hard-coded case count — the number is extracted from the marker at both pinned spots, so adding a case no longer silently ages the measure. DECLARED LIMIT, not an oversight: an opportunity still WAITING at the Worth Gate still falls through to the «no contract yet» wording — the third card lane was returned to the backlog at the stop-patching clause on 01/09, pinned at 528caaa8 (see _acceptance/cong-dang-co-cua/discovery/LAY-VE-LAN-THE.md); reopening it is a separate owner decision. NOTE FOR UPGRADERS: nothing to migrate. Verify by CONTENT, not by number — grep "MSG_O_DA_DONG" and "MSG_HO_SO_HONG" in scripts/gate-card.js; uninstall+install if `claude plugin update` claims you are already latest. v2.7.0 — ONE round (#136, T3, signed with declared limits at the three-round ceiling). No schema change, no migration. What the consumer receives: (1) both decision cards print ONE ready-to-paste command line with every machine-recommended slot already filled — out-of-contract dispositions, «cắt/hoãn: đồng ý cắt», «Treo: phê hết» — leaving only the slots nobody but the human can answer plus the verdict word; the card also exports it as `one_shot` in `--extract`, and the HTML line is byte-equal to the export. Observed (reported from a consumer-repo session the same day, not measured by this repo): a Gate-2 signature under 2.6.0 cost 2 turns for 4 blanks, 2 of them ceremony; under this card's routing rule those 2 ceremony blanks are pre-filled, leaving 2 real questions. (2) A «PHÁN QUYẾT ĐỐI KHÁNG» block on the Gate-2 card carries the adversarial verdict + p0/p1/p2 + disposition counts, so the human reads a verdict instead of the artefacts; on the GATE-1 card, when the adversarial pass could not run (probe-failed, missing under `gap_probe: required`, or unreadable) the card says so and pre-fills NOTHING — fail-closed; the Gate-2 card has no such fall-through yet (declared limit). (3) Three fail-quiet paths closed: an «Ngoài hợp đồng» section written off-template now raises a yellow flag naming OOC-ITEM-TEMPLATE instead of silently vanishing from the card; an unknown `Đề xuất:` token is shown verbatim with the three legal tokens instead of «máy chưa đề xuất hướng nào»; the SẼ/KHÔNG columns classify by the FIRST clause of the Then, so «…, không so hằng» no longer lands a criterion in «KHÔNG làm». (4) When `git config user.name` equals the single `signoff.approvers` entry, approve/signoff write the identity straight away and echo it, no Enter round-trip (IDENTITY-ECHO-RULE, one source + two byte-identical copies). Declared limits: no independent adversarial pass on the final tree; the gate invitation *message* still has no permanent net; irreversibility has no machine-readable flag in the ledger yet. NOTE FOR UPGRADERS: nothing to migrate. Verify by CONTENT: grep "ONE-SHOT-CMD" and "ROUTING-RULE" in scripts/gate-card.js and "suspect_empty" in lib/out-of-contract.js; uninstall+install if `claude plugin update` claims you are already latest.
